faqs.answer: Yes, you can build in teams of up to 4! One member registers and submits the project on CircuitFeed, listing all teammates as collaborators. Every team member will receive their own digital certificate.
faqs.question: Can I participate in a team, or is it solo only?

faqs.answer: Participation is 100% free. Create a free account at https://unorouter.com/ to get your API key. UnoRouter provides free models to build with, no credit card needed.
faqs.question: Is it free to enter? How do I get API access?

faqs.answer: Every eligible builder who submits a working, valid project using UnoRouter by December 12 will receive an official digital Participation Certificate from CircuitFeed, UnoRouter, and Swiftalk. Top 3 projects receive Winner Certificates.
faqs.question: Who receives participation certificates?

faqs.answer: A working project with a live HTTPS URL (Vercel, Netlify, etc.) that integrates the UnoRouter API and includes a description of how UnoRouter was used.
faqs.question: What counts as a valid submission?

faqs.answer: At least the primary submitter must register to submit. We recommend all teammates register so everyone can track announcements and join the community.
faqs.question: Do all team members need to register?

faqs.answer: Yes, boilerplates and UI frameworks are allowed, but the core features and UnoRouter integration must be built during this hackathon.
faqs.question: Can I use existing code or boilerplates?

faqs.answer: Judging is weighted: UnoRouter integration (30%), real-world utility (30%), originality (20%), and execution/UX (20%). Winners are announced on December 25.
faqs.question: How are projects judged?

event.rules_md:
## Eligibility & Guidelines
- **Ages 18+ only.**
- **UnoRouter API Required:** Every project must integrate and use the UnoRouter API for model calls.
- **Originality:** Must be your own original work built during the sprint.
- **Working Demo:** Submissions must include a live, working HTTPS deployment and a public repository.
- **One account per person:** Sign up at unorouter.com with GitHub, Google, or Discord.

## Prize Thresholds (UnoRouter Policy)
- **20+ valid submissions:** All 3 prizes awarded (1st: $100, 2nd: $50, 3rd: $25 in UnoRouter credits).
- **5 to 19 valid submissions:** 1st place only ($100 in UnoRouter credits).
- **Under 5 valid submissions:** No prizes awarded.

## Verification & Awards
- UnoRouter verifies API usage and reserves right of final selection.
- Credits are deposited directly into the winner’s UnoRouter account after judging on 25 December 2099.
